jobs.description: Looking for a stable, well-paid job in production where you can get your hands dirty and make a real impact? Join MGG in Tegelen as a Production Worker (Grinder) and become an integral part of our production process. You'll grind, finish and inspect aluminium products to ensure they meet the highest quality standards. It's a physically active role in a 3-shift system, including night shifts. Perfect if you enjoy hands-on work and aren't afraid of a challenge. Wie zoeken we? You live near Tegelen and have your own place and transport sorted You've got experience working shifts (or at least night shifts) You speak English, German, or Dutch Wat bieden wij je? €20.18 gross per hour (including allowances - see below for the breakdown) Full-time, 37.5 hours a week in 3 shifts Travel allowance Stable, long-term work Real chance of a permanent contract down the line Room to build your technical skills How does the salary work? Your base hourly rate is €16.06. You get a 120% bonus on all your hours - whether you're working early, late, or night shifts. So €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. Plus, you get €0.91 per hour in ADV on top of that: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. Functieomschrijving This job is perfect for you if you like hands-on work that keeps you active during your shift. Your workday will consist of: Grinding and finishing aluminum products Working with tools and machines Loading products into machines and robots Checking product quality It's a plus if you have worked in metal or construction or other production areas, but technical experience is not required. You will work in a 3-shift system with the following hours: 5:45 AM - 1:45 PM, 1:45 PM - 9:45 PM, 9:45 PM - 5:45 AM. Apply now and become part of the team at MGG in Tegelen!
